cases.criterion: Every user-facing public demo message in the describe controller and the shortcode goes through gettext with text domain alt-context, the demo image title fallback is a translatable sprintf, and the demo script depends on wp-i18n and loads alt-context translations.

While a demo run is in flight, a Stop waiting button outside the form stops client polling without sending a request, shows the stopped copy, returns focus to Describe, and keeps the idempotency key for the next Describe of the same image.

The demo retry key resets after a server-terminal failure or a 403 acx_public_demo_run_not_available and survives a client timeout; the timeout copy tells the user to choose Describe again with the same image instead of refreshing.
Every demo client string routes through wp.i18n with text domain alt-context, and the describing percent is formatted for the page locale.
The cold-start wait sentence is identical on the public demo and the admin surfaces, and no fixed two-minute wait promise remains in wait copy.

The Review Queue shows the beta expectations notice (stage, AI-drafted disclosure, qualitative capability, cold-start wait, model tradeoff) between the page heading and the panels, with no new heading.
additional_tests: apps/prototype-wp-alt-context/js/admin/pages/__tests__/WorkbenchPage.control-composition.test.tsx::renders the beta expectations notice between the heading and the panels

cases.criterion: The public-demo-describe and gpu-operator-control ux-maps describe the shipped Stop waiting control and wait copy, and the ux-map lint passes.
With ACX_DESCRIPTION_ADAPTER unset, the description settings and the API profile resolver both default to the seeded profile from one constant.
florence_small is benchmark-only: the describe gate, deploy preflight and smoke gate refuse it as a live demo adapter.

GPU cloud-init serves the llama.cpp runtime image pinned by sha256 digest at all three sites, with explicit --parallel 1, --image-max-tokens 1536, --n-gpu-layers all and f16 KV cache, and without --kv-unified.
One STOPPED to ready cold start is measured end to end on the served build after #10035 is reconciled; wait copy keeps 'several minutes' until a p95 with its n exists.
ADR-017 and the DESCAUTH-1 plan carry the outcome-telemetry amendment (reported event, report_reason, edit_ratio, request_key), and the operator accepts ADR-017.
Each presented generation is classified into exactly one outcome class: applied_unchanged, applied_light_edit, applied_heavy_edit, discarded, superseded_by_regeneration or no_outcome.
Report a problem stores one reported event per request_key; a replayed request creates no second event.
The cost-per-accepted report divides GPU cost by accepted drafts under the sealed definition and exits 2 on missing or inconsistent inputs.
The acceptance analysis plan (estimand, window, floor, sample, interval basis) is sealed by sha256 in a handoff decision before the first counted draft.
cases.artifact: handoff decision on E15-40 carrying the analysis-plan sha256

cases.criterion: The decision extension plans exactly 58 incumbent-q4km cells in 2 operations under the shared decision profile, with argv parity to GPU cloud-init and a deterministic seal.

The extended operator report has 706 review hosts and 115 decision cells, keeps all 192 prior reviews, derives candidate labels from the rule, and the decision builder refuses a rule and manifest mismatch.
58 of 58 Q4 cells are generated on the A10, performance rows are recorded and review-decision-v4 is built; no decision cell is reviewed before v4 ships.
A GPU-unavailable demo refusal charges no demo quota, and cancelling a demo run keeps its charge.
